title: The Voice from Heaven
reflectionQuestion: When Jesus came up from the water, God said, "This is my Son, whom I love." I wonder how it feels to know that God says he loves you, too?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' life -- place under 'Birth of Jesus'/early-life bucket OR a new Jesus' Life category at registration). WATCH-ITEM: warm + gentle, NOT theological -- John prepares the way, baptizes Jesus, the sky opens, the Spirit comes down like a dove, the Father's voice 'This is my Son, whom I love.' The HEART = belovedness/God's delight, turned to the child ('God feels that very same love for YOU... his dear child'). Ties the kid lane's 'you are loved / not alone' thread. Calm, bedtime-gentle register. Soft close ('own'). VOICE_JOHN_BELOVED (tender; fits 'beloved Son').
